name: ContextMenu
title: Components/Lists/ContextMenu
description: Offer record actions at the point of interaction.
purpose: Offer record actions at the point of interaction.
usage: Wrap a focusable target so the menu is also reachable with the keyboard context-menu shortcut. Entry shapes match DropdownMenu.
